name: happy-hop
description: Short vertical two-foot hop: stabilize, crouch with hips and knees, extend, take off, absorb the landing, and return toward HOME.

command.head: unused; zeros
command.trigger: external one-shot policy switch after a stable standing entry; the trigger is not encoded in the observation
command.local_rehearsal_binding: J in the launching terminal of the experimental local scripts/infer_policy.py integration; repeatable after each completed cycle; not an official runtime binding

training.entry_state_source: walking_backlash_model_5000.onnx after 1.0 s of exact-zero velocity command
training.export: scripts/export.py; observation normalizer baked into policy.onnx

eval.sim_proxy: MuJoCo with the BAM XL330 actuator model, output-side backlash encoder view, current saturation, delays, and velocity-recipe randomization
eval.visual_result: complete crouch, two-foot hop, landing absorption, and stable recovery; retained for clean motion rather than maximum height
eval.known_limits: modest jump height; requires a stable standing entry; not trained to take off directly from an active walking stride; never tested on hardware

media.description: One complete simulation cycle: stable stand, crouch, takeoff, landing absorption, and return toward HOME.
